https://registry.npmjs.org/@ffmpeg/core/-/core-0.12.10.tgz

Upstream project and source/build instructions:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm
Pinned source tree declaring core version 0.12.10:
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/tree/f876f907c7e9b9bf51d4ed0b913a855a63ae63fc
The Dockerfile and build/ directory identify the FFmpeg fork and external
codec dependencies with their source URLs and build scripts.
https://github.com/ffmpegwasm/ffmpeg.wasm/blob/f876f907c7e9b9bf51d4ed0b913a855a63ae63fc/Dockerfile
